title: Understanding the Sigmoid Function
text: The sigmoid function, often used in logistic regression, outputs values between $$0$$ and $$1$$. It is defined as \( \sigma(z) $$=$$ \frac{1}{1+e**{-z}} \).

title: Sigmoid Function Output
text: The sigmoid function can never output exactly $$0$$ or $$1$$ for any finite input. It approaches these values asymptotically as the input goes to negative or positive $$\infty$$.

title: Logistic Regression and Sigmoid Function
text: In logistic regression, the output of the sigmoid function represents the probability of the target variable being $$1$$. This probability is never exactly $$0$$ or $$1$$ for finite inputs.
